 Here's today's Final Jeopardy (in the category Movie Promotions ) for Monday, October 19, 2026 (Season 43, Game 26) :
 In 2001 20th Century Fox used a Coast Guard helicopter to "rescue" a prop before a homecoming at this company's Chicago HQ 
 (correct response beneath the contestants)
 Today's Jeopardy! contestants:
 Anthony Cantor , a television & podcast producer from Toronto, Ontario, Canada 
 Aster Wise , a music teacher from Annandale, Virginia 
 Frank Merchlewitz , a senior digital producer from Robbinsdale, Minnesota 
 Frank enters today's game as a 1-day champion with winnings of $14,350.
 Andy's Pregame Thoughts:
 It's time for a new week on Jeopardy! , with Minnesota's Frank Merchlewitz returning as champion to face off against Aster Wise of Virginia and Anthony Cantor of Toronto. (Of course, the latest AI recap bot on YouTube hallucinated today's two challengers out of thin air on Friday.)
 One thing that's already become clear about this week's games, and it's only Monday: the green room camaraderie amongst this week's taping cohort is clearly going to be very high—a number of them banded together to form an Online Quiz League USA team that has already begun play this fall. If the early stats are any indication, it might be worth watching out for Christine Bobal in Thursday's game.
 Of course, for the second consecutive Monday, the J!6 clues are not available on Jeopardy! 's website at the time this article is being written; hopefully they'll be up by the end of the day (and that I won't have a reason to boycott like I chose to last Monday.)

 Correct response: What is Wilson? 
 More Information About Final Jeopardy!:
 (The following write-up is original content and is copyright 2026 The Jeopardy! Fan. It may not be copied without linked attribution back to this page.) 
 In 2001, to promote the release of Cast Away on home media, 20 th Century Fox decided that it needed to "save Wilson" from the island; Wilson, of course, being the volleyball companion of Tom Hanks's character in the movie. Thus, in order to do so, the studio arranged for a Coast Guard helicopter to "rescue" the inanimate object from the island, returning the ball to Wilson headquarters in Chicago, where it arrived to a homecoming parade.
 Wilson Sporting Goods's website itself contains a large amount of behind-the-scenes information about their volleyball's role in the turn-of-the century flick.
 I think that there is enough in the clue to point you towards the correct film; as long as you can remember which important company from the film was based in Chicago, you'll be fine. (And hopefully you don't go down the Ken Jennings/FedEx line.)   
 Game Recap:
 An incredible game saw three successful True Daily Doubles in the main game, with the third one coming from Frank Merchlewitz with three clues left in Double Jeopardy. Anthony Cantor sat second, while Aster Wise sat third.
 Final Jeopardy saw Anthony be the only player to be correct, and that makes him the new champion! He'll be back tomorrow to defend his title.

 Andy's Thoughts:
 I know my Apple smart devices were triggered by the response on the Ceres clue; I wonder who else's were?
 Frank's $34,400 is currently believed to be the record for the highest score entering Final Jeopardy of a player who did not win the game, with the previous record being Chris Becker's $34,000 on February 17, 2016.
 Anthony's $27,200 entering Final Jeopardy, but not leading, is $800 short of the record set earlier in 2026 by Patrick Nolan, who had $28,000 entering Final on April 23 against Jamie Ding.
